usage: The word 仔 (zai2) is used to refer to a son in a family.
It can appear alone or combined with other words to specify a son’s role or relation.
This word is typically a noun and does not change form for singular or plural usage.
In everyday speech, 仔 can be used affectionately or informally to refer to a child or young boy.
It often appears in casual conversations about family or children.
